content.title: Chapter 4
content.subtitle: AN SUSTAINABLE ENERGY TRANSFORMATION IN END-USE SECTORS
content.body: Thank you for joining us for the fourth chapter of the Climate Change-Energy Nexus. We invite you to interact with the closing scenario, and to reflect on how you can take action to move these ideas from ambitions into action.
